SELECT pa.id, t.metatype, f.fieldname, pv.value, pv.id, f.datatype FROM pp_prov_attrib pa, pp_prov_attrib_values pv, fmg_attrib_fields f, fmg_attrib_types t WHERE pv.prov_attribute_id = pa.id AND pv.field_id = f.id AND t.id = pa.attribute_id AND pa.prov_id = :1 ORDER BY pa.id

SELECT distinct pnc.net_id, pnla.network_status_uda status, pnlc.start_date, pnlc.end_date+1 end_date, pnla.ID as hist_id, pnc.id as net_cycle_hist_id FROM pp_prac_net_cycle pnc, pp_prac_net_loc_cycle pnlc, v_uda_prac_net_loc_additional pnla, fmg_codes c1, fmg_codes c2 WHERE c1.type = 'IKA_NON_CON_NETS' AND c2.type = 'IKA_CON_NETS' AND (trunc(pnc.start_date) > trunc(to_date('01/01/2007', 'mm/dd/yyyy')) OR trunc(pnc.end_date) > trunc(to_date('01/01/2007', 'mm/dd/yyyy'))) AND ((trunc(pnc.start_date) != trunc(pnc.end_date) and pnc.net_id = c1.code) or pnc.net_id = c2.code) AND pnlc.prov_id = :1 AND pnc.prac_id = :2 AND pnlc.prac_net_cycle_id = pnc.id AND pnlc.prac_id = pnc.prac_id AND pnlc.id = pnla.prac_net_loc_cycle_id

SELECT PIN, ' ' TIER_NUMBER, AUTHORIZATIONTYPE AUTHORIZATION_TYPE , AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER AUTHORIZATION_NUMBER , EFFECTIVEDATE EFFECTIVE_DATE , ENDDATE END_DATE FROM V_BCBSM_NASCO_PSPCAUTH_PRAC A WHERE PIN = :1 AND AUTHORIZATIONTYPE IN ('R', 'V') AND EFFECTIVEDATE = ( SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVEDATE) FROM V_BCBSM_NASCO_PSPCAUTH_PRAC B WHERE A.PIN=B.PIN AND A.AUTHORIZATIONTYPE = B.AUTHORIZATIONTYPE ) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM( SELECT PIN, ' ' , AUTHORIZATIONTYPE, AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER , EFFECTIVEDATE, ENDDATE FROM V_BCBSM_NASCO_PSPCAUTH_PRAC A WHERE PIN = :2 AND AUTHORIZATIONTYPE IN ('P', 'D' , 'M') ORDER BY AUTHORIZATIONTYPE, NLSSORT(AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER, 'NLS_SORT=WEST_EUROPEA N') ) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PIN , SUBSTR(AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER, 2, 1) , AUTHORIZATIONTYPE , AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER , EFFECTIVEDATE , ENDDATE FROM V_BCBSM_NASCO_PSPCAUTH_PRAC WHERE PIN = :3 AND AUTHORIZATIONTYPE='G' ORDER BY SUBSTR(AUTHORIZATIONNUMBER, 2, 1) , EFFECTIVEDATE DESC)

SELECT DISTINCT T.TYPE_DS, S.CODE, -1 , -1 FROM PP_PROV P , PP_PROV_TYPE T , PP_SPEC S WHERE T.ID = P.PROV_TYPE_ID AND S.ID = P.SPEC_ID AND P.ID = :1 UNION SELECT NVL(V.PORTICO_TYPE_UDA, S.TYPE_DS), NVL(V.PORTICO_SPEC_UDA, S.SPTY_CD), S.SEQ_NUM, V.ID FROM V_UDA_PROV_PIN_ADD V FULL OUTER JOIN BCBSMI_MAIKA_ADDL_TYPE_ID S ON S.PROV_ID = V.PROV_ID AND S.TYPE_DS = V.PORTICO_TYPE_UDA AND S.SPTY_CD = V.PORTICO_SPEC_UDA WHERE TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(V.EFFECTIVE_DATE_UDA, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(V.TERMINATION_DATE_UDA, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND V.ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(V.PROV_ID, S.PROV_ID) = :2 UNION SELECT A.TYPE_DS, A.CODE, S.SEQ_NUM, 1 FROM (SELECT T.TYPE_DS, VM.MAP_VALUE AS CODE, PP.ID, V.PROV_DESIG_UDA FROM V_UDA_PROV_DESIGNATION V, PP_PROV PP, PP_VALUE_MAP VM, PP_PROV_TYPE T WHERE TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(V.EFFECTIVE_DATE_UDA, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(V.END_DATE_UDA, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND PP.ID = V.PROV_ID AND V.PROV_DESIG_UDA = VM.FMG_CODE AND VM.MAP_TYPE = 'MAIKA_DESIG_MAP' AND PP.PROV_TYPE_ID = T.ID) A FULL OUTER JOIN BCBSMI_MAIKA_ADDL_TYPE_ID S ON S.PROV_ID = A.ID AND S.TYPE_DS = A.TYPE_DS AND S.SPTY_CD = A.CODE WHERE A.PROV_DESIG_UDA IS NOT NULL AND NVL(A.ID, S.PROV_ID) = :3
